name: Marching Beyond Time

passive_description.localized:
Increases ATK by <lv>{0}</>.
Enters Wastelab and clears current Wastetime when the wearer casts a Redirect Skill. While in Wastelab, allies gain <lv>1</>stack of Wastetime each time they use a Redirect or Support Skill, up to <lv>3</> stacks. When the wearer uses their Ultimate in Wastelab, they exit Wastelab and consume all Wastetime, increasing Ultimate Crit DMG by <lv>{1}</>, plus an additional <lv>{2}</> per Wastetime consumed. Consuming <lv>3</> Wastetime stacks at once grants an extra <lv>{3}</> DEF Ignore for <lv>{4}</>s.
passive_description.source:
攻击力提高<lv>{0}</>。
装备者释放「变轨技能」后，进入「荒时迷宫」状态并清除当前「荒时」。当装备者处于「荒时迷宫」时，队友每次释放「变轨技能」或「援护技」都将获得<lv>1</>层「荒时」，至多<lv>3</>层。当装备者处于「荒时迷宫」内释放「极轨终结」时，退出「荒时迷宫」并消耗所有「荒时」，使「极轨终结」造成的暴击伤害提升<lv>{1}</>，每消耗1层「荒时」使装备者「极轨终结」造成的暴击伤害额外提升<lv>{2}</>；若一次性消耗了<lv>3</>层「荒时」，则额外获得<lv>{3}</>无视防御效果，持续<lv>{4}</>秒。

tested_hypotheses: Successful wearer Redirect Skill admission enters Wastelab and resets the stack count to zero; switching does not clear it.

Only other living actors' admitted Redirect Skill and Support Skill (engine InputActionRole::Qte; native 「援护技」) inputs add stacks. The wearer is excluded; Normal and switch actions do not add stacks; overflow above three is ignored.

A teammate cast grants its stack on admission even when its packet has zero damage; a rejected command leaves the admitted stage and stack state unchanged. The trigger does not require a connected hit.
The wearer continues observing teammate admissions while off-field. Multiple equipped wearers maintain independent stage and stack state.
A wearer Ultimate admitted outside Wastelab receives no weapon Crit DMG and consumes no stacks. In Wastelab, even zero stacks grant base state Crit DMG, then the stage exits and stacks are consumed.

Consumed-stack Crit DMG is associated with the originating admitted Ultimate command and applies to its complete packet train, including delayed off-field deliveries; it never lingers onto a later unrelated Ultimate.
Three consumed stacks apply DEF ignore only to the wearer from Ultimate admission through, but not including, the exact 70s duration boundary; each delivered hit samples the live window.

Action admission, living-team recipient, stage reset/consumption, packet attribution, and exact expiry semantics are explicit tested model hypotheses. Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
